domain: One ordinary noncritical physical attack, positive armor, zero penetration/reduction and no other modifiers; observed scalars are conditional inputs, not reconstructed build stats.
absolute-bound: gamma(4) * observed AD + half a float32 ULP at observed AD; gamma(n) = n*u/(1-n*u)
wire-bound: With positive armor and no amplification, AD upper-bounds output magnitude; its ULP conservatively bounds wire rounding without consulting observed damage.
interpretation: A declared compatibility band for ordinary float32 arithmetic and the float32 damage observation. This is not proof of the server operation order or a fitted statistical accuracy interval.
selection-rule: Compute from reviewed input AD only, before evaluation. Never widen after observing a mismatch; retain failures. Health-bracket measurement closure is a different bound.
